purpose: Give Mythical Void a truthful adult-facing sharing pack about the father-and-son origin of the studio while protecting the child's identity and distinguishing marketing artwork from real gameplay.

selection.reason: The father-and-son origin is a distinctive, true studio story already explained on the public studio page. It can be shared without a child photograph, name, direct quotation or identifying detail.

audience.primary: Adults, parents and guardians, adult creators, press, industry and partners

identityBoundary.approvedPublicDetail: Kevin's son was nine years old when the project began

professionalNetwork.copy:
The father-and-son story is ready to share

Adults, press and creators can now share wide or square artwork explaining how an Irish father-and-son experiment with imagination and generative AI tools became a playable browser game.

• Both layouts use the clean mythicalvoid.com/studio address with no tracking code.
• The background is labelled as AI-generated marketing artwork, while the framed first-contact screen is real gameplay.
• No photograph, name or identifying detail of the child is used.

See what changed: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#father-son-story-social-assets
